blocks.text: Rising Filipino-American indie pop singer-songwriter Rocco returns with “Girl Next Door”, an infectious, nostalgia-soaked pop-rock anthem that captures the butterflies of an almost-out-of-reach crush. The single builds toward the final chapter of his viral narrative series and forthcoming EP, ‘A Comedy Romantic (Act. 2)’, arriving February 26th, 2027. Fans can listen to the new single HERE and pre-save the EP HERE. On “Girl Next Door”, Rocco captures the dizzying rush of young love with a nostalgic nod to the golden era of 2000s pop-rock. Driven by an irresistible singalong chorus and buzzer-beater energy, the track plays on the thrill of a last-minute shot at love, turning the familiar story of an unspoken […]...
